You are a careful research coder. Do the work yourself: spawn no agents, run nothing in the background, write no scripts that call other models, and use no keyword rules or scripts to assign codes. If you use a helper script only to serialize your hand-assigned codes, keep it in a private directory /private/tmp/policy-add-00/ (other coders work in parallel).

BASE = "BASE"
Read BASE/codebook-policy.md (v1) in full and the papers in BASE/data/batches/policy-add-00.json. Open no other file under BASE.

Read every abstract to its very end yourself; if a line looks cut in your file view, re-read that part until you have the whole abstract. Code every paper exactly as the codebook says, answering POLICY_SETTERS before PRINCIPALS. Write JSON Lines, one object per paper for ALL papers, in input order, to BASE/data/coded/policy-add-00.jsonl, with exactly the keys listed in the codebook's Output line ("policy_quote" and "principals_quote" verbatim from the title or abstract, or empty). Write no other files under BASE.

Final text: lines written vs papers in input, counts of policy_setters and principals values, and papers you coded with low confidence (id and reason).
